_how: Friday routine: call Ryze google_analytics__runRawReport with propertyId "540656492" and request = the JSON below as a STRING (an object 502s). Replace {THIS_START} {THIS_END} {PRIOR_START} {PRIOR_END} {D30_START} with ET dates (this = Fri..Thu, prior = the 7 days before, d30 = THIS_END minus 29 days). Use write_to_file; if the result is truncated (note + fullTextId), read it whole with native__read_tool_output (offset 0, 30000, ...) and save the joined text. Save each as ga4_raw/<Friday>/<file>. Ryze 502s are intermittent: wait 20-30 s and retry the same call. Then also save Hyros hyros_list_calls from {D30_START}T04:00Z to {PRIOR_START}T04:00Z (05:00Z in EST winter if dates fall after the clock change) as hyros_d30_extra.json.
src_landing_note: 2026-11-19: src_landing.json = VSL/booking pages x LinkedIn referral source (linkedin.com, lnkd.in, ...) x landingPage, ~20 rows. GA4 users don't add up across landing pages, so ga4_extract.py moves the SHARE of each page's LinkedIn-referral 'organic' users that landed on /saasreport (the ads' untagged post-text link) to LinkedIn ads: round(li_org_referral x saasreport_landings / all_LinkedIn_landings). (not set), VSL, home and other landings and tagged li links stay organic. Page totals never change. Kept separate from src_funnel.json (already ~600 rows) so its totals and row count are unchanged. If missing, the old split is used.
